before.requirement: For a supported gzip stream, caller-supplied header fields must be reachable through deflateSetHeader followed by deflate.
before.reason: The harness always uses deflateInit and never supplies a gzip header. GZIP build support and the state established by deflateResetKeep are not supplied.

after.requirement: For a supported gzip stream, caller-supplied header fields must be reachable through deflateSetHeader followed by deflate.
after.reason: The same harness still has no custom-header route. GZIP build support and the state established by deflateResetKeep remain unresolved.

claims.reason: If the fixed build supports an initialized gzip stream, the unchanged old harness setup blocks caller-supplied header generation on both sides. The missing build and reset facts prevent establishing that the obligation applies on either side.
missing_information: Effective GZIP definition in the fixed build.
